svg.title: Ayush Kathoke — journey
svg.desc: Journey: 2021 B.Tech IT begins (J D College of Engineering, & Management, Nagpur); 2022 Python & ML (Machine-learning training, with ShapeAI); 2023 Java, certified (NPTEL Java · IIT Kharagpur, CodSoft & Prodigy internships); 2024 Into the industry (Salesforce Intern · SmartBridge, Full-Stack Intern · Pragmatyc); 2025 Graduated · 84.9% (B.Tech in IT, Class of 2025, LeetCode 365 & 500-day badges); 2026 Next: SDE roles (Shipping AI-powered products, Open to full-time roles).
